summary: [Google Analytics 4] objects: GA4 Data API: report rows keyed by dimensions (date, country, deviceCategory, pagePath...) x metrics (activeUsers, sessions, screenPageViews...); metadata via getMetadata; per-request caps: max 9 dimensions, 10 metrics, 4 date ranges. Admin API: Accounts, Properties (properties/{id}), DataStreams, CustomDimensions/Metrics, Audiences, Conversion events. Report identity = property id + query spec + date range (no stable row ids: reports are computed).
